[[No overall control]]{{efn|Labour minority.}} | after_election = | after_party = }} The '''2026 West Lancashire Borough Council election''' was held on 7 May 2026, alongside the [[2026 United Kingdom local elections|other local elections across the United Kingdom]] being held on the same day, to elect 16 of 48 members of [[West Lancashire Borough Council]] in [[Lancashire]], [[England]].{{Cite web |last=mhclgpress |date=2026-02-16 |title=Update on May 2026 local authority elections – MHCLG in the Media |url=https://mhclgmedia.blog.gov.uk/2026/02/16/update-on-may-2026-local-authority-elections/ |access-date=2026-02-17 |website=mhclgmedia.blog.gov.uk |language=en}} ==Summary== ===Background=== In [[2024 West Lancashire Borough Council election|2024]], the [[Labour Party (UK)|Labour Party]] retained majority control of the council.{{Cite news |title=West Lancashire result - Local Elections 2024 |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/election/2024/england/councils/E07000127 |access-date=2026-02-17 |work=BBC News |language=en-GB}}{{Cite web |last=Hughes |first=Ian |date=2024-05-02 |title=West Lancashire council local election results 2024 in full |url=https://www.lancs.live/news/lancashire-news/west-lancashire-council-local-election-29053070 |access-date=2026-02-17 |website=Lancs Live |language=en}} In January 2026, the council asked for the election to be postponed pending local government reorganisation.{{Cite web |date=2026-01-31 |title=Lancashire local elections 2026: where and why they have been cancelled - and when you can now vote |url=https://www.lep.co.uk/news/politics/lancashire-local-elections-2026-preston-chorley-burnley-blackburn-with-darwen-pendle-hyndburn-local-government-reorganisation-5489124 |access-date=2026-02-17 |website=Lancashire Evening Post |language=en}} However it was rescheduled on 16 February 2026.{{Cite web |date=2026-02-16 |title=Lancashire WILL go to the polls this year -
